item.title: Biden Reportedly Weighed Halting Arms to Israel
item.description: Former President Joe Biden reportedly considered cutting off U.S. weapons to Israel after an April 2024 airstrike killed seven World Central Kitchen workers.

item.title: Jeffries Says House Dems Aim to Flip Trump Districts
item.description: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said Sunday his party is on track to win back the House, expressing confidence Democrats can overcome a fundraising gap.
